subject: Azure Partner Center: field signal -> seller mapping (proposed rules)
body:
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@contoso.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Jamie Ortiz <jamie.ortiz@microsoft.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 11:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Azure Partner Center: field signal -> seller mapping (proposed rules)

Thanks Kimberly — attaching our intake snippet and the internal account team list so you can see how signals map to our sellers. We have several inbound referral IDs that are ambiguous (org-level vs. LOB-level). Two asks: (1) can Redwood provide a deterministic mapping when multiple Contoso sellers appear, and (2) we need a clear escalation path if the Partner Center assigns the referral to a Microsoft seller that Contoso disputes. Jamie, any guardrails on Microsoft side?

Best,
Samantha Lee
Senior GTM Ops, Contoso

---

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@contoso.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Jamie Ortiz <jamie.ortiz@microsoft.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Azure Partner Center: field signal -> seller mapping (proposed rules)

Hi Samantha / Jamie — thanks for the sample. I put together a short set of deterministic rules and a fallback escalation flow so Partner Center referrals map consistently to the Contoso seller that will own the account in practice. Attached: pc_signal_to_seller_rules_v1.xlsx and seller-map-sample.csv.

Summary of proposed rules (short):
- Primary signal precedence: Contoso Account Owner (CRM.owner) > Contoso Assigned Seller Email in referral > Azure Marketplace Contact > Territory match (state/region) > Most-recent-engagement signal (last 90 days).
- If multiple sellers tie on precedence, pick the seller with an active consent flag in Partner Center. If still tied, prefer the seller with recent activity (activity window 30d).
- If Partner Center assigns a Microsoft seller and Contoso disputes: route to Contoso GTM Ops (gtm-ops@contoso.com) and Redwood Partner Ops (partner-ops@redwood.com) with a 48h SLA to agree on reassignment; if unresolved, escalate to Microsoft AM and Redwood sales leadership for arbitration.

Operational notes:
- We will push a weekly reconciliation CSV to Contoso (seller-map-sample.csv) showing source signal, chosen seller, and reason code.
- For automation: Redwood can apply mapping rules in the intake webhook pipeline and set a "chosen_seller" attribute on the referral payload to Partner Center so downstream triage uses a single canonical owner.

Next steps / asks from Contoso:
1) Confirm CRM.owner field name and whether Contoso will expose a unique employee_id for sellers in referral payloads.
2) Confirm escalation contacts and desired SLA.
3) Approve the proposed precedence order or propose changes by EOD Thu next week (2026-10-29).

Action items (internal):
- Vanessa: validate the automated reconciliation report format.
- Karthik: confirm implementation effort for chosen_seller attribute on intake webhook.
- Ben: draft a 48h arbitration template email and include MS escalation contacts.

Thanks — I can run a short demo of the mapping rules on Monday if helpful.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Partner Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference

Attachment: pc_signal_to_seller_rules_v1.xlsx (xlsx, 34KB)
Attachment: seller-map-sample.csv (csv, 6KB)

---

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 11:38:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Azure Partner Center: field signal -> seller mapping (proposed rules)

Great outline Kim. Quick notes from ops perspective:
- Reconciliation CSV: include these minimal columns: referral_id, account_id, source_signal, chosen_seller_email, reason_code, timestamp, fallback_flag. That will make automated diffs easy for Contoso and us.
- Chosen_seller attribute: we should signpost the version (v1) and publish schema on our internal drive before the pilot. Karthik, we should aim for an endpoint that accepts retries and idempotency keys.
- Arbitration template: +1 on Ben drafting. Also propose a 'consent_tiebreak' rule that prefers sellers who have accepted "co-sell consent" in the last 180 days. Saves manual back-and-forth.

Vanessa

---

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 13:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Azure Partner Center: field signal -> seller mapping (proposed rules)

Looping in implementation notes:
- We can implement the precedence tree as a lightweight rules engine in the intake lambda. Rough ETA for a pilot (automated mapping + weekly reconciliation push) is 2 sprints (4 weeks) given current backlog. The chosen_seller attribute is trivial to add to the outbound Partner Center payload once rules are applied.
- Edge case: if Contoso provides only an org-level signal but multiple territory-aligned sellers exist, we will default to the Microsoft-assigned seller unless Contoso flags the referral as "contested" in which case we trigger the 48h arbitration flow.
- We should log reason_code values for every mapped referral to enable ML-driven improvements later (reason_code examples: CRM_OWNER, REFERRAL_EMAIL, MARKETPLACE_CONTACT, TERRITORY_MATCH, RECENT_ENGAGE, CONSENT_TIEBREAK, MS_ASSIGNED).

Karthik
Principal Engineer, Partner Integrations

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@contoso.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Azure Partner Center: field signal -> seller mapping (proposed rules)

Draft arbitration email template attached (contoso-referral-12345.pdf). Quick suggestion for the SLA text: 48 business hours for GTM Ops confirmation, then escalate to Microsoft AM + Redwood Sales Leader with a 24h response expectation. Also added a brief privacy note: do not include PII beyond seller email in shared reconciliation CSVs.

Ben Carter
Sales Operations Manager | Redwood Inference

Attachment: contoso-referral-12345.pdf (pdf, 12KB)

---

Reply All thread short responses that follow over next 48h: 
- Samantha: "This looks good — we'll confirm the CRM.owner field and send our seller IDs by Friday."
- Jamie (Microsoft AM): "Confirming we can honour a 48h arbitration window from our side; include me on any escalations."
- Kimberly: "Thanks — I'll schedule a short demo next Monday (2026-10-26) to walk through the rules on a Contoso sample set."
- Vanessa: "I'll validate CSV schema and post to /drive/pc-mappings today."

End of thread.
